summary: rec.gov + FS read: $15, 19 nonelectric back-ins (max 45 ft), 9 reservable late May-Labor Day with a 4-day cutoff, the rest first-come; 2027 season 04-29 to 10-12. Lakefront -> lakeview lead: the shore sites sit 15-25 m back under a stand of trees.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD: stored lakefront -> lakeview (not an --AWH value). The sites nearest Ada Lake are 3, 4, 5, 7, 8 and 10 (RIDB points 45.37059,-88.73233; 45.37025,-88.73259; 45.36985,-88.73245; 45.36954,-88.73229; 45.36906,-88.73193; 45.36883,-88.73165), roughly 15-25 m from the water on imagery, but every one is set back behind a continuous strip of pines and hardwoods: the rec.gov photos of 4, 5, 7, 8 and 10 show the lake between tree trunks beyond the pad, and the imagery shows a 15-30 m conifer belt along the whole shore. Under the canopy/behind-trees rule that is a view. Note rec.gov tags sites 07 and 08 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront'; the stored waterfront_evidence ('open grassy loop ~20-40m from water, thin broken shore fringe') is not what the photos show. Sites 3, 7, 8 are reservable; 4, 5, 10 first-come; all are sold by the night.
SEASON: 2027 runs 04-29 to 10-12 (rec.gov rate seasons); stored 04-30/10-13 is the 2026 calendar.

FS PAGE CONTRADICTION: the FS page says 'All sites are on a first-come basis' in its site-length section but elsewhere sends visitors to recreation.gov; rec.gov holds 9 reservable sites in peak season.
Phone 715-674-4481 (Laona office) confirmed. Pin 45.3696,-88.7315 is within 10 m of the RIDB site centroid (45.36958,-88.73147): fine.
